_help.name: The name shown at the top left of the panel.
_help.lat: Your latitude in decimal degrees (north is positive).
_help.lon: Your longitude in decimal degrees (west is negative, e.g. -105.0).
_help.refresh_minutes: How often the no-key sources (NWS, Open-Meteo) refresh, in minutes (at least 2).
_help.tempest_udp: true = listen to a Tempest hub on the home network for live readings; false = don't. Restart WeatherDial after changing.
_help.tempest_udp_port: The network port the Tempest hub broadcasts on (normally 50222).
_help.tempest_station_id: Which Tempest station to use (setup fills this in from your token). null = the first station on the token.
_help.weather_display_dir: Only if Weather Display runs your station: its folder, e.g. "C:\wdisplay" (write each \ twice in this file). Then live readings come from its file instead of the hub. Leave empty otherwise.
_help.source_minutes: Refresh a particular source more or less often, in minutes, e.g. {"AccuWeather": 10}. Use the names from the Sources tab; at least 2. Check that source's daily limit first.
_help.accuracy_backfill_days: How many past days to fill in for the accuracy scores (global models' past forecasts and your Tempest's actual highs and lows).
_help.index_groups: Which AccuWeather health & lifestyle indices the Health tab shows, by number, in groups. List all numbers: python weather.py --indices
